title: Project
description: Source file for one project (config/projects/<id>.json): the shared project definition plus a required id that must match the filename. The assembled ecosystem schema references #/$defs/project directly, so the id is not part of generated output.

id.description: Canonical project identifier. Must match the filename (without .json) and the key in the assembled ecosystem config.

project.description: A project as it appears in the assembled config (no id). Unknown properties are rejected where this is referenced, via unevaluatedProperties.

destination.description: The project's one primary Gateway destination.

repository.description: GitHub repository name under the configured username. Omit when the project has no repository.

repositoryVisibility.description: Whether the repository can be publicly accessed. Required with, and only allowed with, repository. Independent of listing, status and deployments.

path.description: Path of the project inside a shared repository. Requires repository.

related.description: Canonical IDs of related projects. A relationship is undirected and declared once, on one of the two projects (checked by scripts/validate.mjs).

deployments.description: Public deployments. Omit when the project is not deployed.

key.description: must not be empty or whitespace-only

trimmedString.description: must be a non-empty string without leading or trailing whitespace

projectId.description: must be a camelCase identifier (a lowercase letter, then letters and digits)

repositoryName.description: must be a GitHub repository name (letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-'), not a URL

deploymentName.description: must be a lowercase slug (a-z, 0-9, single '-' between parts)

listing.description: Portfolio visibility only. Hidden records are still published in the generated JSON.

destination.description: Primary Gateway destination: a main destination (games, learning, tools, products, platforms, career, labs) or a special one (central-station, sun, moon).

repositoryPath.description: must be a relative path inside the repository: '/'-separated, non-empty segments, no leading '/', drive letter, backslashes, '.' / '..' segments, or leading/trailing whitespace

subdomain.description: must be one or more lowercase DNS labels separated by '.' (a-z, 0-9, '-', not starting or ending with '-')

deployment.description: A deployment is either hosted under the primary domain (subdomain) or hosted elsewhere (url). Exactly one of the two is required.

name.description: Deployment identity, unique across the ecosystem. Consumers use it as a public slug (Support's ?project=).

url.description: Explicit external deployment URL (e.g. GitHub Pages), used as-is including any path and trailing slash. Must be an absolute https:// URL. Not allowed together with subdomain or aliases.

subdomain.description: must be null (apex/root domain) or one or more lowercase DNS labels separated by '.' (a-z, 0-9, '-', not starting or ending with '-')

aliases.description: Additional subdomains that resolve to this deployment.

localizedText.description: Localized text. English is required; Indonesian is optional. Consumers fall back to English when a locale is missing.

meaningfulString.description: must not be empty or whitespace-only

httpsUrl.description: must be an absolute https:// URL with a host and no whitespace

technologies.description: Technologies used, in display order. Free-form names; duplicates are rejected case-insensitively.

tags.description: Lowercase kebab-case identifiers, in display order.

items.description: must be a lowercase kebab-case identifier (a-z, 0-9, single '-' between parts)

projectLinks.description: Extra project links keyed by lowercase name (e.g. documentation, figma). Do not repeat repository or deployment URLs; those are derived from existing fields.

propertyNames.description: must be a lowercase link name (a-z, 0-9, '-', starting with a letter)

imagePath.description: must be a repository-relative path starting with assets/ (no URLs, backslashes, '..' or leading dots; characters A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ - only) ending in .png, .jpg, .jpeg, .webp, .svg, .avif or .gif

pdfPath.description: must be a repository-relative path starting with assets/ (no URLs, backslashes, '..' or leading dots; characters A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ - only) ending in .pdf

mediaImage.description: An image in a project's media gallery.

projectAssets.description: Local asset references for a project. All optional; paths live under assets/projects/<projectId>/ (checked by scripts/validate.mjs).
